# Heretic ### Training-free language model modification **Remove censorship**, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more.
All in an afternoon, on your gaming PC. [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1447831134212984903?color=5865F2&label=discord&labelColor=black&logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/gdXc48gSyT)     [![Matrix](https://img.shields.io/badge/Matrix-black?logo=matrix&style=for-the-badge)](https://matrix.to/#/#heretic:matrix.org)    [![Follow us on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/badges/resolve/main/follow-us-on-hf-md-dark.svg)](https://huggingface.co/heretic-org)    [![Codeberg mirror](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codeberg%20mirror-black?logo=codeberg&style=for-the-badge)](https://codeberg.org/p-e-w/heretic)
-----   [![#1 Repository of the Day](https://trendshift.io/api/badge/repositories/20538)](https://trendshift.io/repositories/20538)     [![Model and download statistics](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9b5a660-7ef9-43c7-991c-fd9d63ea8bd8)](https://heretic.sdad.pro/) ## Modify any LLM that you can run on your hardware[^1] [^1]: Heretic supports on-the-fly 4-bit model quantization with bitsandbytes, which can reduce the amount of VRAM required to process a model to the same amount that is used to run a typical quantized version of it, at a slight accuracy cost. Set the `quantization` option to `bnb_4bit` to enable this. Heretic is a unique tool that lets you do what only corporations with access to massive computing power usually do: *Modify,* rather than merely run, language models. It does not perform expensive training; rather, it uses a collection of mathematical techniques to steer behavior based on contrasting example prompts and matching scorers. Heretic can, depending on the configuration: * **Suppress refusals/remove censorship** (this is the [default action](/config.default.toml)) * Reduce slop ([`config.noslop.toml`](/config.noslop.toml)) * Reduce humor ([`config.nohumor.toml`](/config.nohumor.toml)) * Reduce sycophancy ([`config.nosyco.toml`](/config.nosyco.toml)) * Alter emotional alignment ([`config.emotions.toml`](/config.emotions.toml)) * Shorten response length ([`config.terse.toml`](/config.terse.toml)) and many, many other things. ### :bangbang: Using Heretic does NOT require understanding how language models work internally :bangbang: In fact, you can go from zero to removing censorship from your first model [in a matter of seconds](#usage). Heretic supports most dense models, including many multimodal models, several different MoE architectures, and many modern hybrid models.
